versions.changelog: Sync existing infra403/opennews-2 from https://github.com/6551Team/opennews-mcp, main commit e329f36187e4a51a0878823e4fdd4d8f42134e80, directory openclaw-skill/opennews. Replace outdated SKILL.md and package.json with exact upstream bytes, including current news categories, market coverage and API documentation. Excludes only generated skill-card.md. Preserve display name Opennews, owner and slug. No example commands or upstream scripts executed.

Initial release of OpenNews crypto news skill.

- Search and filter crypto news by keyword, coin, source, and category via the OpenNews 6551 API.
- View AI-powered article ratings, trading signals, and summaries.
- Supports real-time news feeds over WebSocket.
- Requires an API token (`OPENNEWS_TOKEN`) for authentication.
- Includes common workflows and cURL examples for market overviews and high-impact news filtering.
